g.text: AA05 - Security Audit Log Consultation by Administrator
[user lacks ADMINISTRATOR role locally in SPA]
[actor does not possess ADMINISTRATOR role (even if multi-role, e.g., EMPLOYEE + CUSTOMER)]
[actor possesses ADMINISTRATOR role (e.g., ADMINISTRATOR or ADMINISTRATOR + MANAGER)]
redirect to login (AA04 session expiration flow)
show denied feedback without protected data
Audit writes are retried once for transient persistence failure. If retry
fails, preserve the original denial and report a sanitized requestId through
protected operational alerting. This does not change the AA04 401 session flow.
Access is permitted if the user has the ADMINISTRATOR role among their assigned roles
(multi-role users with ADMINISTRATOR are allowed). Having other roles does not block access,
but lacking ADMINISTRATOR results in HTTP 403. The API remains authoritative
